title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Incentive Statement — Amount of the Spend-Milestone Bonus
content:
**Statement.** The milestone year spend of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is the total of the spend entries posted to the agreement less the spend removed by its agreement-year reset entries. When the milestone year spend has reached the tier's spend milestone, the milestone bonus credited is the tier's spend-milestone bonus points, credited as they stand. When it has not reached the spend milestone, the milestone bonus credited is nothing.

### Outcomes

| Milestone year spend | Milestone bonus credited |
|---|---|
| at or above the tier's spend milestone | the tier's spend-milestone bonus points |
| below the tier's spend milestone | nothing |

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

An agreement's spend entries total USD 260000.00 and its reset entries have removed USD 150000.00, leaving a milestone year spend of USD 110000.00. On a tier whose spend milestone is USD 100000 and whose spend-milestone bonus points are 5000, the milestone has been reached and 5000 points are credited. On a tier whose spend milestone is USD 250000, it has not, and nothing is credited.
